feature: coordinator mutex hardening + residue cleanup — the lease mutex wait is tunable (ORCH_MUTEX_WAIT_MS, default 60000 ms; was hard-coded 20 s) and the acquisition is retried with exponential + jittered backoff (ORCH_MUTEX_RETRIES, default 2); the JS side bounds each attempt by the same value plus a start/exit margin (the old 30 s flat wait reported a failure even when the helper had already exited); killed helpers no longer leave lock tickets (age-based reclamation at transaction start AND on every coordinator-directory resolution, ORCH_MUTEX_TICKET_TTL_MS default 600000 ms; the helper polls its release file every 100 ms so tickets vanish within ~300 ms instead of ~1 s); queue-backoff end-to-end failures now carry the block-level reason

rootCauses.falseFailure: scripts/core/lease-lock.ps1 WaitOne(20000) hard-coded; on a loaded machine nine contending parents legitimately queue past 20 s (observed: 2/9 'Coordinator mutex acquisition failed' during the 0.8.0 release-copy full suite, while the same file passed in isolation in 16.6 s)
rootCauses.longTail: the JS wait was a flat 30 s and never observed the helper's exit — a helper that gave up at 20 s still cost the caller 30 s
rootCauses.ticketLeak: a killed or timed-out PowerShell helper never runs its own finally; lock-*.ready/.release accumulated without bound in the machine-wide coordinator directory (measured: 576 files / 770 KB)
